name: RelayMind
description: RelayMind local gateway as an OpenClaw model provider: the client-owned alias relaymind-client-tools over the loopback chat API; OpenClaw keeps its sessions, tools, and approvals.

providerAuthChoices.choiceHint: The token `relaymind serve` printed when it started
providerAuthChoices.cliDescription: RelayMind application token (printed by relaymind serve at each start)

baseUrl.description: The gateway's loopback /v1 URL, such as http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 (localhost, 127.0.0.0/8, or [::1] only).

diagnosticsPath.description: Optional absolute file path: one JSON line per inference attempt (turn, attempt, Idempotency-Key, RelayMind run ID or unavailable, outcome, code, native run and UI links). Never the token or message content.

executionMode.description: Sent as X-RelayMind-Execution-Mode on every request. parallel_demo is not a mode of this alias.

limits.description: Copies of the gateway's configured limits; a limit not set is not advertised.

externalContextLimit.description: external_model.context_limit of the gateway's launch file; the window advertised in auto and external_only.

localContextLimit.description: The local context of the pinned model manifest's launch settings; the window advertised in local_only.

maxCompletionTokens.description: chat.max_completion_tokens of the gateway's launch file; the advertised output limit.

maxRetries.description: The plugin's own retries after 429 overloaded (same Idempotency-Key) or 504 deadline_exceeded (a new key), only before any answer content. 0 is one attempt.
